full_prompt_en: This is a square, storybook-like painted illustration of two young figures facing one another beneath a blue-green sky filled with golden cloud and passing birds. On the left, a shorter young woman in a reddish-brown outer layer and blue lower garment looks up toward the taller figure. Her dark hair is tied back in a low, loose knot, and her face is shown in clean profile. On the right, a tall young man in a long dark coat and red neckwear leans slightly toward her, looking down with a quiet expression. Wind lifts his short dark hair toward the right. Their bodies are close but do not touch, leaving a narrow glowing gap between their faces. Behind them, large warm yellow cloud banks rise from the lower center and sides, their soft curved edges contrasting with the flat cool sky above. Several birds cross the upper region, some large at the corners and others reduced to thin marks near the distant center. The bird silhouettes and windblown hair create motion around the still exchange. Light seems to come from the bright cloud opening behind the figures, tracing warm edges along profiles while their coats remain darker, simplified shapes. The painting uses smooth color fields with softly brushed transitions in the clouds and crisp, economical contours around the people. Small airborne strokes add texture without filling every part of the sky. No text is visible. The overall composition is tender and spacious, placing an intimate face-to-face moment against broad luminous weather and a loose rhythm of flight.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、近似故事绘本的绘画插画，两名年轻人在布满金色云层和掠过飞鸟的蓝绿色天空下相向而立。左侧，较矮的年轻女子穿红褐色外层衣物和蓝色下装，仰头望向较高的人。她的深发在后方松松挽成低髻，脸呈清楚侧面。右侧，高个年轻男子穿长深色外套、系红色颈饰，略向她倾身，安静地低头看她。风将他的短深发吹向右边。两人靠近却没有触碰，脸之间留出一道狭窄发光间隙。身后，大块暖黄色云从下方中央和两边升起，柔软弯曲的边缘与上方平坦冷色天空相对。几只鸟掠过上部区域，有的在角落显得较大，有的在远方中央缩成细线。鸟的剪影和被风吹动的头发让静止的对望周围有了动感。光似乎来自人物身后明亮的云间开口，沿侧面勾出暖边，外套则保持较深、简化的形状。绘画采用平顺色域，云里有柔和刷笔过渡，人物周围是清楚而节制的轮廓。少量空中笔痕增加肌理，却没有填满整片天空。没有文字。整体构图温柔而开阔，将亲密的面对面瞬间置于辽阔发光天气与松散飞行节奏之间。
style_prompt_en: The painted illustration balances flat, clearly bounded focal shapes with broad, softly brushed atmospheric color. Muted blue-green is warmed by luminous cream, honey yellow, and a few reddish-brown accents. Backlight gathers along selected edges, allowing darker near forms to remain simple while the pale field carries the emotional brightness. Large curved masses rise behind a narrow central interval; smaller diagonal marks move across the open upper area. The surface is mostly smooth, with thin painterly variation in transitions rather than heavy impasto. Negative space remains generous, giving each gesture and small accent room to register. The overall effect is lyrical and gently windswept, with intimate scale held inside expansive light.
style_prompt_zh: 这种绘画插画以平坦、边界清楚的焦点形状平衡宽阔而柔刷的空气色彩。低饱和蓝绿由发亮奶油色、蜜黄和少许红褐强调加暖。逆光聚在选择性的边缘，让较深近处形体保持简单，浅色画域则承载情绪亮度。宽大的弯曲色块在狭窄中央间隔后方升起，较小斜向笔痕在上方开阔区域移动。表面大体平顺，过渡处只有细微绘画变化，而非厚重堆色。负空间充足，使每个动作与小强调都有显现余地。整体效果抒情而轻轻迎风，亲密尺度被容纳在辽阔光线之中。
theme_en: Two young figures facing one another beneath circling birds and golden clouds
theme_zh: 两名年轻人于飞鸟和金色云下相向而立
name: Neo-romanticism
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
